title.narrative: The labour market statistics and information system has provided gender responsive, and evidence-based information and knowledge, and has promoted and planned for sustainable and decent work

description.narrative: The intervention aims to support national efforts to strengthen Afghanistan’s labour market statistics, standards, and information systems to generate reliable, timely, and gender-responsive labour market data. Through targeted technical assistance, the initiative enhances institutional and technical capacity to design and implement improved statistical surveys and to effectively use administrative and other statistical sources. This approach aligns with international labour standards and the SDG Global Indicator Framework, ensuring consistency and comparability of labour statistics across sectors. By improving the production, analysis, and dissemination of labour market information aligned with international standards, the initiative provides a solid foundation for evidence-based policy formulation and monitoring that promotes decent work, inclusive growth, and sustainable development. It further supports policy-oriented research, capacity-building for labour market analysis, and the strengthening of dialogue among social partners, ensuring that employment and labour policies are grounded in evidence and responsive to both women’s and men’s needs. Amid Afghanistan’s complex political and economic environment, characterized by security risks, fiscal limitations, and institutional challenges, the intervention fosters greater cooperation, policy coherence, and data-driven decision-making. It particularly emphasizes advancing women’s economic participation and empowerment despite prevailing restrictions, contributing to gender equality and the creation of sustainable, decent work opportunities for all.
